description: Carmel Market (Hebrew: שוק הכרמל‎, Shuk HaCarmel) is a marketplace in Tel Aviv, Israel. The market is bordered by Allenby Street and Magen David Square and the market is principally located along Carmel Street (which becomes King George Street after Magen David Square), but has expanded over time to streets such as Nahalat Binyamin Street.
